description: This file defines a set of reusable UI components for a card layout in React, including polymorphic containers and specific subcomponents such as header, title, description, content, and footer. It includes TypeScript types for flexible component rendering and styling.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A polymorphic React component that renders a card container with optional elevated styling.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: A React functional component rendering the header section of a card with bottom border.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: A React functional component rendering the title inside a card with specific styles.

methods.name: CardDescription
methods.description: A React functional component rendering a description paragraph within a card.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: A React functional component for rendering main content area in a card.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: A React functional component rendering the footer area of a card with top border and flex layout.
